published_basis.title: Bounds for variables with few occurrences in conjunctive normal forms
core_results_used: surplus sigma(F) and a witnessing variable set are polynomial-time computable
every nonempty lean clause-set satisfies mu_vd(F) <= nM(sigma(F))
there is a polynomial-time satisfiability-equivalent autarky-reduction of arbitrary F to some F' satisfying the min-variable-degree bound
the actual witness autarky for the critical case is not known polynomial-time in general

candidate_reduction.name: DEGREE_SURPLUS_BOUND_NORMALIZATION
candidate_reduction.rule: While the current formula violates mu_vd(F) <= nM(sigma(F)), apply the published polynomial-time satisfiability-equivalent clause reduction; stop once the inequality holds.
candidate_reduction.exactness: SAT-equivalence of the reduced clause-set is theorem-backed.
candidate_reduction.computability: The reduction-to-bound is polynomial-time; however a reconstructing autarky certificate is not generally known polynomial-time.
candidate_reduction.state: Clause deletion only; reduced formula size is at most input size.

SAT.family: E_n equivalence cycles from R44AK, n>=3
facts: for a nonempty proper set V of cycle variables with c connected components, the incident cycle edges are |V|+c, so |Gamma(V)|-|V| = |V|+2c >= 3
for V=all variables the expansion is n
SAT.effect: The degree-surplus stopping condition already holds on arbitrarily large SAT formulas.

facts: U_n has deficiency 1 and is matching-lean, so sigma(U_n)>=1
taking all variables gives sigma(U_n)<=delta(U_n)=1; hence sigma(U_n)=1
UNSAT.effect: The stopping condition also already holds on arbitrarily large UNSAT formulas.

strong_low_surplus_barrier.theorem: LEAN restricted to surplus 1 is coNP-complete.
strong_low_surplus_barrier.meaning: Even after forcing the structural parameter surplus to its first positive layer, exact recognition of general leanness retains coNP-complete difficulty.
strong_low_surplus_barrier.TRUMP_effect: A strategy that hopes degree/surplus normalization alone makes the complete general lean-kernel distinction polynomial is blocked.

facts: the critical formulas are satisfiable matching-lean clause-sets with delta=sigma>=1 and mu_vd>nM(sigma)
a critical variable subset F[V] can be found in polynomial time
finding the corresponding nontrivial autarky in polynomial time is the explicit conjectural step in the cited work
MLCR_open_subproblem.possible_value: A polynomial witness-autarky algorithm would strengthen proof-carrying reconstruction for this reduction, but by itself would not prove universal 3SAT descent.

next_admissible_math.rule: Attack the exact conjectural witness-construction problem mathematically; do not promote it to P=NP even if solved unless the remaining universal core is also discharged.
